description: This file defines the TypeManagementOptions class, which contains configuration settings related to type management for in-place upgrades within the Orleans framework. It includes a property for the refresh interval of the cluster grain interface map, with a default value set to one minute.

classes.description: Configuration options for managing types during in-place upgrades in Orleans.
